_comment: Connection-manifest for the Video department. verify-wiring.sh reads this and checks each required cfg_key.

connection_points.name: kie-api-key
connection_points.description: Kie.ai API key for the Video department's Kie-first generation (AI Video Generator Specialist, Movie Producer). The client's own key; the accepted alias family is defined once in shared-utils/secret_names.json (see alias_source), never restated here. Advisory (required:false) because the department doctrine allows a client-supplied BYOK vendor key for tools Kie does not carry, so a box without a Kie key is degraded, not unwired; the Movie Producer pipeline (Skill 47) stays Kie-only and refuses to generate without it. Lifecycle, rate limits, and credit rules: 07-kie-setup/references/kie-common-rules.md.

connection_points.name: ghl-api-key
connection_points.description: GoHighLevel API key for the Video department to upload completed video assets and thumbnails to the GHL media library.

connection_points.name: ghl-location-id
connection_points.description: GHL location ID for targeting the correct sub-account media library.
